description: This file provides type guard functions to identify various property types and component nodes used in a rendering system, along with some utility functions to check for specific data structures. It defines and exports functions to verify if a given object matches certain expected interfaces related to UI components, values, and data structures, which facilitates type safety and runtime validation within the project.
